title: Spread the two slits
hook: Change slit separation and predict fringe spacing.
misconception: fringe spacing doubles when slit separation doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply Δy ≈ λL/d to compare fringe spacing when slit separation changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With two narrow slits in the small-angle limit with fixed wavelength and screen distance, Δy ≈ λL/d. When slit separation doubles, fringe spacing becomes ½ times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model Δy ≈ λL/d; scaling exponent -1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider two narrow slits in the small-angle limit with fixed wavelength and screen distance, with a nonzero initial result. If slit separation triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on fringe spacing?
recall.why: Apply Δy ≈ λL/d under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 1/3.
